items.what: Bare wrapper variants 'WITH WRAPPER' / 'WITHOUT WRAPPER' (no ARRAY, no CONDITIONAL/UNCONDITIONAL) must parse and round-trip; the issue only shows 'WITH/WITHOUT ARRAY WRAPPER'.

Optional qualifier+ARRAY combinations 'WITHOUT CONDITIONAL WRAPPER' and 'WITH UNCONDITIONAL ARRAY WRAPPER' must parse and round-trip; the issue text never mentions CONDITIONAL/UNCONDITIONAL combined this way.
items.quote: "JSON_QUERY(content, 'strict $.HY.*' WITHOUT CONDITIONAL WRAPPER)" / "'strict $.HY.*' WITH UNCONDITIONAL ARRAY WRAPPER"

items.what: The generated Trino SQL must contain the exact substrings 'WITH ARRAY WRAPPER' and 'WITHOUT ARRAY WRAPPER' (round-trip fidelity of the wrapper clause), not just parse without error.
items.quote: self.assertIn("WITH ARRAY WRAPPER", out); self.assertIn("WITHOUT ARRAY WRAPPER", out)

reason: The issue demonstrates only the ARRAY-wrapper forms, but the hidden tests also require bare 'WITH/WITHOUT WRAPPER' and CONDITIONAL/UNCONDITIONAL variants to parse and round-trip, plus exact output substrings. These follow from the natural minimal fix (making the ARRAY and CONDITIONAL/UNCONDITIONAL tokens optional in the JSON_QUERY wrapper grammar), so they are guessable rather than not_inferable.
